items.reason: The PR adds abstract getShortcut() without a default in server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/grants/OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.java:33, breaking compilation of existing custom implementations lacking it. services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/encode/DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.java:70-76 unconditionally calls it on every registered grant factory during postInit, so previously compiled implementations can throw AbstractMethodError and prevent startup.
